verdict.rationale: EBANX's own marketing site says merchants can make "mass payouts" on its platform, which is a first-party bulk operation, though only for disbursements. There is no documentation of how bulk work is submitted or tracked, or of bulk refunds, captures or other operations. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints or file-upload mechanics, bulk operations beyond payouts (e.g., refunds, captures, cancellations), per-item status/error handling for batches, developer-doc depth beyond a marketing line, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: On the same platform, make payments, whether in single or mass payouts, both locally and internationally
